data_clock.description: Discrete macro-bout transitions from KPMS segmentation. Raw frame start/end indices preserved for exact 40 fps video alignment.
data_clock.duration_representation: Bout count for explicit HSMM phase duration; continuous physical seconds (frames / 40.0) logged in parallel for kinematics and video HUD.

vocabulary.raw_provenance: Original KPMS syllable IDs (0-99) retained for every bout to enable raw overlay and fine-grained verification.
vocabulary.chain_length_constraint: Strictly 3 to 5 syllables per candidate chain for immediate deduction and visual tracking

continuous_features.pca_fitting: PCA(n_components=3) fit strictly on training cohort animals (124,310 macro-bouts) from KPMS 10D latent_state.

arm_1.name: Arm 1: seqNMF Baseline
arm_1.description: Rigid temporal template convolution with factorized syllable loading matrix W and activation matrix H.

arm_2.name: Arm 2: Categorical HSMM (Syllables Only)
arm_2.description: Staged hidden semi-Markov model with discrete Level-4 syllable emissions and explicit bout duration transitions.

arm_3.name: Arm 3: Mixed HSMM (Syllables + Kinematics + Pose Latents)
arm_3.description: Staged HSMM combining categorical syllable emissions with regularized Gaussian continuous kinematic emissions.

standardized_trajectory_scorer.representation: 240D Kinematic Trajectory Vector (48 uniform temporal samples x 5 features: x, y, dx, dy, speed_norm)
standardized_trajectory_scorer.reference_construction: Model-independent pooled reference: median trajectory calculated across all high-confidence training episodes for each theme.
standardized_trajectory_scorer.metric: Cosine Similarity (-1.0 to +1.0) against the pooled reference.

canonical.name: Canonical Exemplar (P0 Convention)
canonical.description: Episode with the highest continuous trajectory similarity to the canonical execution reference.

p80.name: P80 Fidelity
p80.description: 80th percentile similarity candidate, showing high quality with natural variability.

p99.name: P99 Extreme Boundary
p99.description: 1st percentile similarity candidate (lower 99th quantile bound), testing tail flexibility.

ordinary.name: Ordinary / P-nothing
ordinary.description: Representative median/random occurrence reflecting typical everyday motif execution.

renderer_configuration.layout: 1x3 Widescreen Canvas (1920x400 total resolution; 3 synchronized panels of 640x360)
features: Synchronized multi-animal comparison (different animals across panels wherever available)
Observed Syllable HUD: Real-time display of actual observed raw KPMS syllable ID, observed Level 4 meta-token, and bout duration in seconds
Inferred Phase State: Current motif progression stage displayed in brackets alongside observed token
2D Trajectory Inset: Centered animal path trace with past/future trajectory context
Multi-format export: High-definition MP4, first-frame PNG thumbnail, and animated GIF preview
